name: Figure AI
summary: Humanoid robotics company targeting general-purpose physical work.
overview: Figure AI is developing humanoid robots for industrial and commercial tasks.
bull_case: A capable general-purpose robot could address major labor shortages across industries.
bear_case: Hardware reliability, safety, and unit economics may delay broad commercialization.

intelligence.description: Figure develops general-purpose humanoid robots and the AI systems intended to control them.
company: Figure is developing humanoid robots for industrial and eventually broader commercial uses, alongside its Helix AI system for embodied intelligence.
The company said its Series C exceeded $1 billion and set a $39 billion post-money valuation in September 2025.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Figure is a leading private-market bet on humanoid robotics. Its valuation depends on whether reliable hardware and embodied AI can move from demonstrations to cost-effective deployment.

changed.text: Series C exceeded $1B at a $39B post-money valuation.

takeaways: Figure is one of the highest-valued private humanoid-robotics companies.
The key challenge is commercial reliability and unit economics.
The Series C set a disclosed $39B valuation.
